# Malcolm X Official Website

> > The official website documenting the life, legacy, and teachings of Malcolm X, civil rights leader and Nation of Islam minister.

This site serves as the authoritative digital resource for Malcolm X (born Malcolm Little in Omaha, Nebraska), chronicling his transformation from street hustler to one of America's most influential civil rights activists. It covers his work with the Nation of Islam under Elijah Muhammad, his philosophy of Black nationalism and self-defense, and his lasting impact on African-American history and the struggle for freedom and equality.

## Key Topics

- Malcolm X
- Nation of Islam (NOI)
- Elijah Muhammad
- Civil rights activism
- African-American history
- Black nationalism
- Self-defense philosophy
- Marcus Garvey Movement
- Muslim Mosque, Inc.

- Omaha, Nebraska
- Malcolm Little
- Civil rights leadership

## Essential Biography

- [Malcolm X – The Official Website of Malcolm X](https://www.malcolmx.com): Official homepage for Malcolm X, civil rights leader from Omaha, Nebraska
- [Biography – Malcolm X](https://www.malcolmx.com/biography): Life story of Malcolm Little from Omaha to civil rights activism
- [Achievements – Malcolm X](https://www.malcolmx.com/achievements): Malcolm X's civil rights achievements and Nation of Islam leadership
- [Chronology – Malcolm X](https://www.malcolmx.com/chronology): Timeline of Malcolm X's life from birth in Omaha to assassination

## Teachings and Legacy

- [Quotes – Malcolm X](https://www.malcolmx.com/quotes): Collection of Malcolm X quotes on civil rights, activism, and philosophy
- [Eulogy – Malcolm X](https://www.malcolmx.com/eulogy): Ossie Davis's 1965 funeral eulogy at Faith Temple Church in Harlem
